properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC signing secret for JWTs. Must decode to at least 32 bytes. Set via the JWT_SECRET environment variable.

properties.name: app.jwt.access-expiry-ms
properties.description: Access token time-to-live in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.jwt.refresh-expiry-ms
properties.description: Refresh token time-to-live in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Explicit origins allowed by CORS. Set via the CORS_ORIGINS environment variable.

properties.name: app.frontend-url
properties.description: Public web app URL used to build password-reset links.

properties.name: app.mail.enabled
properties.description: Enables transactional email delivery (password resets and other branded messages). SMTP must also be configured.

properties.name: app.mail.provider
properties.description: Optional provider preset: gmail, outlook, office365, sendgrid, mailgun, postmark. Supplies a host/port when SMTP_SERVER/SMTP_PORT are blank.

properties.name: app.mail.host
properties.description: SMTP server host. Set via SMTP_SERVER. Required when mail is enabled unless a provider preset supplies it.

properties.name: app.mail.port
properties.description: SMTP port. Set via SMTP_PORT; defaults to the provider preset port, 465 with implicit TLS, otherwise 587.

properties.name: app.mail.username
properties.description: SMTP username (usually the mailbox address). Set via SMTP_EMAIL. Leave blank for an unauthenticated relay.

properties.name: app.mail.password
properties.description: SMTP password or provider API key/app password. Set via SMTP_PASSWORD. Never commit this value.

properties.name: app.mail.use-ssl
properties.description: Use implicit TLS (SMTPS, normally port 465) instead of STARTTLS. Set via SMTP_USE_SSL. When blank, port 465 implies TLS.

properties.name: app.mail.starttls
properties.description: Enable the STARTTLS upgrade on non-implicit-TLS ports. Set via SMTP_STARTTLS.

properties.name: app.mail.starttls-required
properties.description: Refuse delivery when the SMTP server does not offer STARTTLS. Set via SMTP_STARTTLS_REQUIRED; relax only for a trusted local relay.

properties.name: app.mail.timeout-ms
properties.description: SMTP connection, read and write timeout in milliseconds. Set via SMTP_TIMEOUT_MS.

properties.name: app.mail.from
properties.description: Sender address for transactional email. Set via MAIL_FROM; falls back to SMTP_EMAIL so provider From checks pass.

properties.name: app.mail.brand.app-name
properties.description: Product name shown in email titles, the wordmark and the footer. Set via MAIL_APP_NAME.

properties.name: app.mail.brand.company-name
properties.description: Legal/company name shown in the email footer. Set via MAIL_COMPANY_NAME.

properties.name: app.mail.brand.eyebrow
properties.description: Small uppercase line under the wordmark. Set via MAIL_BRAND_EYEBROW.

properties.name: app.mail.brand.logo-url
properties.description: Optional absolute HTTPS URL to a raster logo (PNG/JPG). Blank uses the built-in CSS wordmark that every email client renders. Set via MAIL_LOGO_URL.

properties.name: app.mail.brand.primary-color
properties.description: Primary button colour as a hex value. Set via MAIL_PRIMARY_COLOR; invalid values fall back to the SmartOS red.

properties.name: app.mail.brand.accent-color
properties.description: Accent colour for the wordmark, eyebrow and info notices. Set via MAIL_ACCENT_COLOR.

properties.name: app.mail.brand.support-email
properties.description: Support address shown in the email help block. Set via MAIL_SUPPORT_EMAIL.

properties.name: app.mail.brand.support-phone
properties.description: Support phone number shown in the email help block. Set via MAIL_SUPPORT_PHONE.

properties.name: app.mail.brand.support-hours
properties.description: Support opening hours shown in the email help block. Set via MAIL_SUPPORT_HOURS.

properties.name: app.mail.brand.footer-address
properties.description: Company postal address shown in the email footer. Set via MAIL_FOOTER_ADDRESS.

properties.name: app.mail.brand.privacy-url
properties.description: Privacy policy URL used in the email footer. Defaults to the web app's /legal?doc=privacy page. Set via MAIL_PRIVACY_URL.

properties.name: app.mail.brand.terms-url
properties.description: Terms of service URL used in the email footer. Defaults to the web app's /legal?doc=terms page. Set via MAIL_TERMS_URL.

properties.name: app.mail.brand.help-url
properties.description: Help centre URL used in the email help block and footer. Defaults to the web app's /help page. Set via MAIL_HELP_URL.

properties.name: app.mail.provider
properties.description: Optional SMTP provider preset; set via EMAIL_PROVIDER.

properties.name: app.mail.host
properties.description: SMTP host; set via SMTP_SERVER or a provider preset.

properties.name: app.mail.port
properties.description: SMTP port; set via SMTP_PORT.

properties.name: app.mail.username
properties.description: SMTP login username; set via SMTP_EMAIL.

properties.name: app.mail.password
properties.description: SMTP login password; set via SMTP_PASSWORD.

properties.name: app.mail.use-ssl
properties.description: Whether SMTP uses implicit TLS; set via SMTP_USE_SSL.

properties.name: app.security.trust-forwarded-headers
properties.description: Trust forwarding headers supplied by a trusted reverse proxy.

properties.name: app.security.rate-limit.login-max-failures
properties.description: Maximum failed login attempts per rate-limit window.

properties.name: app.security.rate-limit.login-window-seconds
properties.description: Login failure rate-limit window in seconds.

properties.name: app.security.rate-limit.forgot-max-requests
properties.description: Maximum password-reset requests per rate-limit window.

properties.name: app.security.rate-limit.forgot-window-seconds
properties.description: Password-reset request rate-limit window in seconds.

properties.name: app.security.rate-limit.passkey-max-failures
properties.description: Maximum failed passkey attempts per rate-limit window.

properties.name: app.security.rate-limit.passkey-window-seconds
properties.description: Passkey failure rate-limit window in seconds.

properties.name: app.security.password-reset.token-ttl-minutes
properties.description: Password-reset token time-to-live in minutes.

properties.name: app.security.password-reset.expose-dev-token
properties.description: Exposes password-reset tokens in API responses for local development only.

properties.name: app.webauthn.rp-id
properties.description: WebAuthn relying-party identifier.

properties.name: app.webauthn.rp-name
properties.description: WebAuthn relying-party display name.

properties.name: app.webauthn.allowed-origins
properties.description: Browser origins allowed to complete WebAuthn ceremonies.

properties.name: app.webauthn.user-verification
properties.description: WebAuthn user-verification preference.

properties.name: app.webauthn.timeout-ms
properties.description: WebAuthn ceremony timeout in milliseconds.

properties.name: app.webauthn.challenge-ttl-seconds
properties.description: WebAuthn challenge time-to-live in seconds.

properties.name: app.cloudinary.cloud-name
properties.description: Cloudinary cloud name for image uploads. Blank disables uploads (501) while URL-based images keep working. Set via CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME.

properties.name: app.cloudinary.api-key
properties.description: Cloudinary API key. Set via CLOUDINARY_API_KEY.

properties.name: app.cloudinary.api-secret
properties.description: Cloudinary API secret. Set via CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET.

properties.name: app.cloudinary.max-bytes
properties.description: Maximum accepted upload size in bytes.
